note: SYNTHETIC TEST DATA. AI-made faces of people who do not exist. Boxes [x0,y0,x1,y1] in pixels. Face boxes come from the YuNet detector run on each source portrait, moved by our own placement (box_method says how). skin_bucket is MEASURED (ITA angle on the face pixels of the source portrait; light >41, medium 10..41, dark <=10); prompt_skin_word is what the prompt said. Text drawn on the pictures is only the label.
